reason: The patch's Javadoc at GroupPermissionEvaluator.java:~142-147 says the method returns "IDs of groups with view permission" and does not mention any V2 exception. But GroupPermissionsV2.java:121-123 returns `groupResource.getId()` for resources found by `findByType(GROUPS_RESOURCE_TYPE)`, and only the "Groups" type resource has a type set (AdminPermissionsSchema.java:271-275). So V2 returns that resource's internal ID, not group IDs.
